func _run_tests() -> void:
	var main := await instantiate_main_scene()
	if not check("main", main != null, "La scena principale deve essere impostata e caricarsi senza errori"):
		return
	var player := find_by_name(main, "Player")
	if not check("player", player != null, "La scena deve contenere il nodo Player"):
		return
	var sign_node := find_by_name(main, "Sign")
	if not check("sign", sign_node != null, "Nella scena deve esserci il nodo Sign"):
		return
	var has_interact := has_function(sign_node, "interact")
	if not check("has_interact", has_interact, "Il nodo Sign deve avere un metodo interact()"):
		return
	var lever := find_by_name(main, "Lever")
	if check("lever", lever != null, "La leva preesistente deve rimanere nel livello"):
		var prev_lever_state = get_prop(lever, "is_on", false)
		call_if_exists(lever, "interact")
		var new_lever_state = get_prop(lever, "is_on", false)
		check("lever_works", new_lever_state != prev_lever_state, "La leva deve continuare a cambiare stato con interact()")
	var initial_read = get_prop(sign_node, "is_read", true)
	check("initial_false", initial_read == false, "La variabile is_read del cartello deve essere inizialmente false")
	if player is Node3D and sign_node is Node3D:
		var p3d := player as Node3D
		var s3d := sign_node as Node3D
		p3d.global_position = s3d.global_position + Vector3(0, 0, 1.5)
		p3d.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
		await wait_physics_frames(5)
		await tap_action("interact")
		await wait_physics_frames(5)
	var after_read = get_prop(sign_node, "is_read", false)
	if not after_read:
		call_if_exists(sign_node, "interact")
		after_read = get_prop(sign_node, "is_read", false)
	check("is_read_true", after_read == true, "Dopo l'interazione, la variabile is_read del cartello deve diventare true")

@export var walk_speed: float = 5.0

@onready var spring_arm: SpringArm3D = $SpringArm3D
@onready var ray_cast: RayCast3D = $SpringArm3D/Camera3D/RayCast3D


func _ready() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
		if ray_cast.is_colliding():
			var collider = ray_cast.get_collider()
			if collider and collider.has_method("interact"):
				collider.interact()


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var input_dir := Input.get_vector("move_left", "move_right", "move_forward", "move_back")
	var move_dir := (transform.basis * Vector3(input_dir.x, 0, input_dir.y)).normalized()
	velocity.x = move_dir.x * walk_speed
	velocity.z = move_dir.z * walk_speed
	move_and_slide()
